title: tunna signing vectors
description: Oracles for the canonical request and signature (ADR-0003, wire.md section 3). A signer passes when, for every case, it derives the expected canonical string and signature from the inputs. In header mode the runner derives X-Tunna-Date from 'time'; it is not listed in 'headers'. Test secrets only.

mode.description: header: time is the request timestamp and the output is an Authorization header. presign: time is the absolute expiry and the output is a query string.

secret.description: Test-only secret. Real secrets never appear in this repository.

path.description: Decoded path segments. The signer encodes them per the encoding vectors.

query.description: Decoded [name, value] pairs, any order, excluding the credential parameters that presign mode adds itself.

headers.description: Request headers as sent, original case and whitespace. Only those named in signed_headers enter the canonical request.

signed_headers.description: Header names the client chose to sign, any case, any order.

time.description: Unix seconds. Timestamp in header mode, expiry in presign mode.

canonical.description: The exact canonical request string, newline-joined.

authorization.description: header mode: the full Authorization header value.

query.description: presign mode: the full canonical query string including the credential parameters and the signature, as it should appear in the URL.
